# rotate log files weekly

command:
sudo sh -c 'set -eu
log=/var/log/inventory/app.log
printf "%s\n" rotation-test-before-open-fd >> "$log"
exec 3>>"$log"
printf "%s\n" rotation-test-before-force >&3
inode_before=$(stat -c %i "$log")
/usr/sbin/logrotate -f -s /tmp/inventory-logrotate-test.status /etc/logrotate.d/inventory
inode_after=$(stat -c %i "$log")
printf "%s\n" rotation-test-after-force >&3
exec 3>&-
printf "INODE_BEFORE=%s\nINODE_AFTER=%s\n" "$inode_before" "$inode_after"
test "$inode_before" = "$inode_after"
printf "%s\n" CURRENT_LOG && cat "$log"
printf "%s\n" ROTATED_ARCHIVE && gzip -cd "$log.1.gz"
printf "%s\n" FILES && ls -l "$log" "$log.1.gz"
rm -f /tmp/inventory-logrotate-test.status'
